featured_reviews.name: JG
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very 3rd class studio. Reasons are below:
1) Far away from Naigaon Railway station. If any Medical emergency no conveyance available. We have to Walk down up to Chinchoti and then we have to wait for Auto.
2) Property not maintained
3) No proper directions to go Saniya Studio
4) Lots of Garbage is laying since long time
5) No Safety Equipments if any Fire
6) No Signage boards if any Fire
7) They are providing rooms for Artist and Jr. Artist whenever Film shoot is there. No cleaning in the rooms and no water in Toilets.

featured_reviews.review_text: Saniya film studio is situated at chinchoti. Its very close to the highway just after hp petrol pump. But very difficult to find manually . Bad road for tyres.
